title: The coded-machine test reverses the state and alphabet bounds.
details: Avigad, version 2007-01-09, section 2.6, printed pp. 38–39 (PDF pages 42–43). Instruction(k,n,m) bounds the state coordinates by n and the symbol coordinates by m. The following Machine(M) display calls InstructionSeq((M)_2,(M)_1,(M)_0), although the immediately following definitions assign mNumStates(M)=(M)_0 and mNumSymbols(M)=(M)_1. The intended call is InstructionSeq((M)_2,(M)_0,(M)_1). The explanatory sentence after InstructionSeq also interchanges the words states and symbols. The numerical coding treatment uses an explicitly specified finite table for the corpus's combined write/move model and does not adopt this reversed test. This finding does not certify the source's sketched converse compiler.
